state.review: Adversarial review of the selected definitive business/authority owner boundary. Treat the supplied row as a proposal; do not infer omitted policy.

owners.declaredIdentity: UUIDv5 tenant+program+normalizedKind/identifier; explicit createRequestId retained and compares complete initial normalized terms. Revision expected; review/approval DecisionId=RequestId but review lacks retry comparison. Retirement compares generated timestamp so handler retry fails. Physical append OCC.
owners.selectedIdentity: Tenant + ProgramId + normalized kind/identifier retain the existing deterministic UUIDv5 owner algorithm. Supplied DraftId must equal that existing identity; later selected commands use CommandId and the exact draft/version/review bindings.
owners.invariant: One tenant/program/kind/identifier has immutable identity/source creation, revisioned authored content, exact verified-source accepted review and independent approval that publishes strictly later effective versions; retired commitment remains terminal.
owners.boundaryRationale: Current pending authors, accepted review and current-revision responsibility conflicts must remain atomically coherent. Past effective version list/history query and old scope sets can leave current command state. Provider/service owners can be checked at admission using values.

owners.declaredIdentity: Per incident id is a valid stable creation identity. SameInitial/revision/assessment helpers compare server RecordedAt; fresh handler clock makes an exact client retry conflict or append. No selected RequestId guard.
owners.selectedIdentity: Tenant / compliance-incidents / IncidentId, with immutable ProgramId. IncidentId is the selected immutable creation identity; later selected commands use CommandId and the exact incident/version/proof bindings.
owners.invariant: One incident version may be assessed once; current-version independent description decision and required follow-up eligibility gate advancement; incident resolution requires every admitted follow-up work item completed.
owners.boundaryRationale: Keep current version, assessment and eligibility/independence gate atomic. Historical versions/decisions are immutable histories; do not split current gate simply by entity nouns. Required work selection can be sealed exact-version content with authority proofs.

owners.declaredIdentity: Tenant / programs / programId, creation uses context.RequestId; original create content remembered; revision for mutations; criteria selection has narrow latest retry special case. Portia appends against the hydrated physical stream position; a logical revision does not create another physical boundary.
owners.selectedIdentity: Tenant + caller ProgramId; creation uses that identity and later mutations use caller CommandId.
owners.invariant: Program target dates must form a coherent chronological plan; one program identity has immutable creation intent. Criteria selection separately chooses current edition.
owners.boundaryRationale: Remove historical criteria-selection collection from command state while preserving authoritative as-of selection proofs. Keep coherent program date plan together. A separate current criteria-selection owner is a possible targeted split, not yet a required new aggregate. Splitting individual plan dates would lose chronological validation. Dropping criteria history without replacing authoritative temporal lookup would lose exact baseline/readiness source semantics. A stale projection cannot substitute for the contributor current-source check. Splitting current edition from program plan causes no observed write-rule loss, but also needs no invented new business lifecycle.

owners.invariant: One mapping tuple proposal and immutable approved successor line.
owners.mustPreserve: Independent review approves exact pending proposal and supersedes only its predecessor.

owners.declaredIdentity: tenant/controls/controlId; controlId derives tenant+program+normalized identifier. Create stores creation requestId+initial content and distinguishes changed intent. Later Review/Approve/Retire/periodic commands do not generally retain request intent; content revision differs from physical stream revision.
owners.selectedIdentity: Tenant / controls / ControlId; supplied ControlId must equal the existing tenant/program/normalized-identifier UUIDv5. Later selected commands use CommandId and the exact control/version/review bindings.
owners.invariant: Only the exact current draft or retirement can be independently reviewed then activated, and accepted successor/retirement changes one control version line without overlapping effective intervals. Responsibilities cannot create unwaived conflicts with decisions already made on the exact revision.
owners.boundaryRationale: Splitting draft review/approval from the current target or conflicting responsibilities would break the exact accepted review and historical SoD invariant. Keep that narrow decision context atomic; approved versions, old scopes, and full decision/retirement histories can be read-side records.

owners.invariant: One evaluation including steps, conclusions, review and deviation dispositions. A retest is a new evaluationId using this same type and an immutable predecessor evaluation/version proof.
owners.mustPreserve: Material deviation source proof, immutable procedure version, reviewer independence, and explicit minor-deviation disposition.

owners.declaredIdentity: tenant/control-evaluation-plans/controlId; stable planVersionId passed from request; Define compares complete procedure/author/current version data on identity reuse and checks expectedVersion.
owners.selectedIdentity: Tenant / control-evaluation-plans / ControlId, with immutable ProgramId. PlanVersionId identifies the selected immutable definition operation and its complete procedure/author/source intent.
owners.invariant: A plan version has a stable identity and immutable procedure; only a successor to the current plan version can be appended and exact duplicate identity must have the same content.
owners.boundaryRationale: The procedure steps belong together: validation and eventual evaluation operate over one exact ordered procedure snapshot. Old immutable plan versions do not need to stay in active command state; keep current version/identity admission while history is a projection.

owners.invariant: One planned/attested/corrected/reviewed occurrence for a control performance window.
owners.mustPreserve: Occurrence facts bind exact frozen plan and evidence requirements; one business window has one identity across all generators.
